name: datapipeline
description: AWS Data Pipeline configures and manages a data-driven workflow called a pipeline.

subcommands.name: activate-pipeline
subcommands.description: Validates the specified pipeline and starts processing pipeline tasks.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Adds or modifies tags for the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: create-default-roles
subcommands.description: NOTE: Support for this command has been deprecated and may fail to create these roles if they do not already exist.

subcommands.name: create-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a new, empty pipeline.

subcommands.name: deactivate-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deactivates the specified running pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deletes a pipeline, its pipeline definition, and its run history.

subcommands.name: describe-objects
subcommands.description: Gets the object definitions for a set of objects associated with the pipeline.

subcommands.name: describe-pipelines
subcommands.description: Retrieves metadata about one or more pipelines.

subcommands.name: evaluate-expression
subcommands.description: Task runners call EvaluateExpression to evaluate a string in the context of the specified object.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline-definition
subcommands.description: Gets the definition of the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: list-pipelines
subcommands.description: Lists the pipeline identifiers for all active pipelines that you have permission to access.

subcommands.name: list-runs
subcommands.description: Lists the times the specified pipeline has run.

subcommands.name: poll-for-task
subcommands.description: Task runners call PollForTask to receive a task to perform from AWS Data Pipeline.

subcommands.name: put-pipeline-definition
subcommands.description: Adds tasks, schedules, and preconditions to the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: query-objects
subcommands.description: Queries the specified pipeline for the names of objects that match the specified set of conditions.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes existing tags from the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: report-task-progress
subcommands.description: Task runners call ReportTaskProgress when assigned a task to acknowledge that it has the task.

subcommands.name: report-task-runner-heartbeat
subcommands.description: Task runners call ReportTaskRunnerHeartbeat every 15 minutes to indicate that they are operational.

subcommands.name: set-status
subcommands.description: Requests that the status of the specified physical or logical pipeline objects be updated in the specified pipeline.

subcommands.name: set-task-status
subcommands.description: Task runners call SetTaskStatus to notify AWS Data Pipeline that a task is completed and provide information about the final status.

subcommands.name: validate-pipeline-definition
subcommands.description: Validates the specified pipeline definition to ensure that it is well formed and can be run without error.
